headline: Disney adds dozens of 3D movies to its app on Meta Quest
summary: Disney added more than 60 3D movies, including The Avengers, Black Panther and Avatar, to its Disney Plus app on Meta Quest headsets. Accounts differ on whether the movies are being sold or are included for existing Disney Plus subscribers.

claims.statement: Disney added 3D movies to its Disney Plus app on Meta Quest.

sources.quote: The Disney+ app on Meta Quest now includes 3D movies
The VR Disney Plus app on Meta Quest now has 3D movies

claims.statement: More than 60 3D movies, including The Avengers and Black Panther, are available.

sources.quote: more than 60 3D movies to the Disney Plus app on Meta Quest
The 3D movies you can check out include The Avengers and Black Panther

claims.statement: The update also lets users watch Avatar in 3D high frame rate.

sources.quote: you can watch Avatar in 3D HFR at home

discrepancies.explanation: Engadget describes the 3D movies as something Meta is selling, while The Verge says they are available to existing Disney Plus subscribers.

quotes.quote: Meta is starting to sell 3D films too.
will be available to Disney Plus subscribers
